usedFor: MailerLite Classic holds subscribers, and viaSocket utilities pauses the workflow after each “New Subscriber Added”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Subscriber Added” in MailerLite Classic, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A pause after a new subscriber spaces out the steps that follow, such as a welcome message.

watchOut: “New Subscriber Added” is polling and “Pause Workflow” waits the minutes you set, so allow for both delays.
